svg.title: Effect of slope with a shared fixed point

cc:Work.dc:title: Effect of slope with a shared fixed point
cc:Work.dc:description: Identical axis scales and three iterations in each panel. q=0.2 converges faster than q=0.8. q=-1.2 alternates and diverges.
